_builder: kind=v2direct -> chain1._mk_plan(('v2',pair,in_is_t0,out)) -> chain1_v2._v2_build. kind=v2hop -> chain1_v2._v2_xfer_cd + two _v2_swap_cd with hop 1's `to` pointing at hop 2's PAIR (Router02's own _swap chaining). NO Router02, NO approve, NO new calldata class.
_param: v2direct: [pair, token0]. v2hop: [[pair1,token0],[pair2,token0], hub]. token0 (not a bool) so one row serves either direction.
